entry.author: Whangarei District Council
entry.summary:
We are so pleased to see the difference this project is making for the Morningside community!

In the past, the area frequently experienced flooding when heavy rainfall coincided with high tides. This project has transformed the catchment into a more controlled and resilient stormwater system, using a combination of gravity diversion and managed pumping.

Delivered by WDC, Weir Consultants, and United Civil, the project is helping reduce flooding, improve environmental outcomes, and shows how smart, collaborative stormwater solutions can be delivered within tight timeframes and budgets.
